candidates.title: How Cohere Health digitizes clinical policies using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: In this post, you learn how Cohere Health built a multi-tenant agentic architecture on AgentCore using AgentCore Runtime’s secure MicroVM isolation, unified tool access through AgentCore Gateway, AgentCore Memory, and the Agent Skills open standard to rapidly scale policy digitization capabilities, while preserving transparency, version control, and human oversight.

candidates.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
candidates.summary: OpenAI said this model, which is still in development, reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems.

candidates.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
candidates.summary: Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents instead of people. It uses less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks, helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.

candidates.title: How TReNDS automates root-cause analysis with Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: TReNDS, a research center at Georgia State University, built an agentic AI pipeline on Amazon Bedrock and the open-source Strands Agents SDK that automatically investigates production errors in real time, reducing root-cause analysis from 15 to 30 minutes of manual work to under 60 seconds.
